claim: Statue of Hope on the west pedestal sets $7B; the prayer-room show of mu63_spirits runs only on the branch that matches the half of the room the player is in when the actor spawns (box (10,00)-(20,10) = east branch, flag $7E).

trial.control: enter scene $63 from the west door (scene $5F warp) with a Statue of Hope in the inventory, stand in tiles (06,06)-(0A,08), use the statue
trial.forced: same, but write $7B := 1 directly before loading scene $63 and then load it from each door; also enter from the east door (scene $65) and use the statue on the west pedestal
observe: whether the show starts (music #1B, spirit sprites, 'The Sun god... Rama...' text)

confirms: the show is armed for the side where the player spawns and starts on the flag; with the flag preset the actor only spawns the placed statue
refutes: the show depends on the pedestal that receives the statue rather than the spawn position

claim: $7E drains the Mu scenes $5F, $60, $61, $62, $64 and $65 (scene_meta loads map_mu_drained_effect, label 17) and $7B alone gives the half-drained tilemap (labels 16, 19, 1A, 1B) in $5F-$62; the tint thinker uses COLDATA #$28/#$41 when $7B is set.

trial.control: load scenes $5F, $60, $61, $62, $64, $65 with both flags clear
trial.forced: load the same scenes with $7B only, then with $7E only, then with both
observe: COLDATA writes ($2132) of the tint thinker

confirms: scene_meta order: $7E tested before $7B; $7B alone gives the half-drained look in $5F-$62 only; $64 and $65 change only with $7E
refutes: any scene of the list shows a different state than the gates predict

claim: Rama Statue on the first pedestal sets $80 and on the second sets $81; once both are set, mu66_altar1 reloads scene $66 at pixel (00F8,01D8) if the player is outside tiles (00,00)-(20,20).

trial.forced: write $80 and $81, once with the player inside tiles (00,00)-(20,20) and once outside
observe: scene id after the map change

refutes: $FF is set only by the thinkers in $5C and $5D
